chunks: Al-Saffar narrated from Mu'awiyah ibn Hukaym, from 'Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from al-Kahili, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام about madhy, and he said: Whatever of it is accompanied by desire, then perform wudu (ablution). And that which indicates that these reports are to be understood as recommendation is that...

key_terms.الِاسْتِحْبَابِ: recommendation rather than obligation in legal application
key_terms.الْأَخْبَارَ: the reports or narrations being referenced collectively
key_terms.الْمَذْيِ: pre-seminal fluid under discussion in the legal ruling
key_terms.بِشَهْوَةٍ: with desire; the qualifying condition mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: Does madhy require wudu (ablution) according to this hadith from al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This report addresses the ruling concerning madhy and mentions performing wudu (ablution) when it occurs with desire. The appended phrase indicates that the compiler is treating such reports as carrying the sense of recommendation rather than obligation.
